tools.name: fs.stat
tools.description: Check whether a workspace path exists and return its type (file or directory) and file size in bytes. Does not read file contents.

tools.name: fs.list_directory
tools.description: List the direct children of a workspace directory (not recursive): names, types, and whether the listing was cut off by the entry limit.

path.description: Workspace-relative directory path; use . for the workspace itself

tools.name: fs.read_text
tools.description: Read a UTF-8 text file in the workspace. Fails, without returning partial content, if the file exceeds the host's read limit.

path.description: Workspace-relative path of the text file

tools.name: fs.read_json
tools.description: Read and parse a UTF-8 JSON file in the workspace. Fails on invalid JSON or if the file exceeds the read limit.

path.description: Workspace-relative path of the JSON file

tools.name: fs.write_text
tools.description: Write a UTF-8 text file in the workspace. The parent directory must exist. Only creates new files unless overwrite is true.

path.description: Workspace-relative path of the file to write

overwrite.description: Allow replacing an existing file (default false)

tools.name: fs.make_directory
tools.description: Create a directory in the workspace; succeeds if it already exists. With parents=true, missing parent directories are created too.

parents.description: Also create missing parent directories (default false)

tools.name: fs.delete_file
tools.description: Delete one existing file in the workspace. Requires human confirmation by default. Does not delete directories.

tools.name: text.search
tools.description: Find literal, non-overlapping matches and return character offsets.

tools.name: text.replace
tools.description: Replace all occurrences of a nonempty literal string.

tools.name: text.split
tools.description: Split text using a literal separator, subject to the item limit.

tools.name: text.join
tools.description: Join a list of strings using a separator.

tools.name: json.parse
tools.description: Parse strict JSON text and return data.

tools.name: json.stringify
tools.description: Serialize a JSON object as UTF-8 text.

tools.name: json.get
tools.description: Read a value from an object using a JSON Pointer.

tools.name: csv.parse
tools.description: Parse CSV text into rows of strings.

tools.name: csv.format
tools.description: Format rows of strings as CSV.

rows.description: Rows, each a list of strings

tools.name: hash.sha256
tools.description: Calculate the SHA-256 digest of UTF-8 text.

tools.name: url.build
tools.description: Append percent-encoded query parameters to a URL.

query.description: Query parameters (string, integer or Boolean values)

tools.name: http.request
tools.description: Send an HTTPS request to a host-approved origin. Non-GET/HEAD requests require human review. Redirects are returned without following them. The body is decoded with the declared charset; format "text" returns an HTML page as its title and visible text. Long bodies are cut and marked truncated.

url.description: HTTPS URL on a host-approved origin

method.description: GET, HEAD, POST, PUT, PATCH or DELETE

headers.description: Extra request headers; credentials are added by the host

body.description: Request body text (not allowed for GET and HEAD)

query.description: Query parameters encoded by the runtime.

format.description: raw (default) returns the body as sent; text returns an HTML page as readable text

tools.name: tools.define
tools.description: Create or edit a declarative tool using a validated definition. Required fields: name (decl.name), description, parameters (name to type), steps (id, tool, arguments). References are {$input: parameter} or {$step: previous_id, path: JSON Pointer}. HTTP method and URL must be literal. Set overwrite=true to edit.

overwrite.description: Replace an existing definition with the same name (default false)
